{{Top|leg}}
'''Carbon-Durasteel Armor''', also known as '''Carbon-Nanofilament Armor''', was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and vehicles.<ref name="EDGE">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

Produced by numerous [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturers, Carbon-Durasteel was made from a complex lattice of carbon nanotubes embedded with spun threads of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]].<ref name="EDGE" /> Molecularly bonded to a ship's hull, they provided exceptional protection over standard [[durasteel]] at the expense of maneuverability, being applicable to craft of all sizes.<ref name="EDGE" /> The [[CC-7700/E interdiction cruiser]] made use of carbon-nanofilament armor to greatly increase its defensive ability; it was thought that it would take a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] traveling near its top speed to even begin to ram through the plating.<ref name="MINDOR">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
